name: Merge Racer
tagline: Merge piggies, power up your cars, and race to #1.
description:
A casual merge-and-race game built for web portals. Merge piggies on a 3×3 grid to power them up, then drop them into race lanes to drive your cars. Each piggy chips away at the rival's lead every second.

Beat the rival in all three lanes to climb the leaderboard to #1.

Built with Phaser 3 and plain JavaScript, for Poki.
